name: abstinence
description: Long term goal of avoiding something that may have brought pleasure or relief. Each instance of abstinence may be easy or a very difficult act of willpower.

guidance.description: If you need help abstaining from something addictive, consider finding a support group or professional help.
For general tips, see guidance on 'willpower'.

variations.name: hesitant abstinence
variations.description: A dissonant desire to avoid something while also partly wanting to indulge.
perceptions: Something appealing tempts you away from the goal of abstinence.
Social pressure from an important person or group tempts you away from the goal of abstinence.
The goal isn't really that important.
The downside of abstaining is significant.

variations.name: satisfied abstinence
variations.description: Successfully living up to an avoidance goal may bring satisfaction for living up to your own expectations.
perceptions: Something really appealing tempts you away from the goal of abstinence.
Social pressure from an important person or group tempts you away from the goal of abstinence.

commentaries.quote: Complete abstinence is easier than perfect moderation.
I pass the test. I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.
commentaries.attribution: J.R.R. Tolkien in Fellowship of the Ring
